desc: The Frigidaire 1.7 Cu. Ft. Over-The-Range Microwave FMOS1746BB is the ultimate combination of functionality, convenience, and style, designed to elevate your cooking experience. Whether you need to quickly heat up a meal, cook a dish from scratch, or keep your kitchen fresh with its built-in ventilation system, this microwave has you covered.
hl: Get meals on the table in minutes with three different Quick Start options that allow you to make meals, faster.
Over-the-range microwave doubles as a hood offering ventilation with two fan speeds.
Adjust cook time and power levels based on the food type and weight.
Accommodates your larger dishes and bowls.
Big bowls and large casserole dishes are no problem with an extra-large glass turntable.
Easily clean the aluminum grease filter by putting it in the dishwasher.
